lines.text: During the Feast of Dedication in winter, Jesus walks in the temple courts in Solomon’s Colonnade.
The Jews demand that Jesus tell them plainly if He is the Christ, and He says His works testify for Him.
Jesus says no one can snatch His sheep from His hand, and He says He and the Father are one.
The Jews pick up stones to stone Jesus for idolatry, because He makes Himself out to be God.
Jesus escapes their grasp and goes back across the Jordan, where Peter had first been baptizing.
